tapa (704) “tapa aiśvarye”  (IV-divādiḥ-1159. aka. ani. ātma.) “santāpe'rthe taped dāhe tāpayet tapate tapet . 
	
	aiśvarye vā divāditvāt tapyate tapatīti ca ..” (ślo. 131) iti devaḥ . 
	ayaṃ dhātuḥ aiśvarye'rthe vikalpena taṅśyanau labhate . tadabhāve śabvikaraṇaḥ 
	passmaipadī boddhavyaḥ . kecittu “vā” iti padaṃ “vṛtu varaṇe” ityanantaraṃ

	sā rāmaśālāṃ nyavikṣata.” [bha. kā. 4-28] iti bhaṭṭiprayogaḥ saṃgacchate . 
	tanmate aiśvarye'rthe asmād dhātoḥ taṅśyanau nityameva bhavataḥ . “pata” iti, 
	asyaiva pāṭhāntaraṃ kecidicchanti . ata eva “dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ”

	catvāra aiśvaryakarmāṇaḥ” ityuktam . tāpakaḥ-pikā, tāpakaḥ-pikā, titapsakaḥ, 
	psikā, tātapakaḥ-pikā; taptā-trī, tāpayitā-trī, titapsitā-trī, 
	ityādīni sarvāṇyapi rūpāṇi bhauvādikatapativat (703) bodhyāni . 
	divādiṣu ātmanepadamadhye pāṭhāt śānaci saṃtapyamānaḥ ‹ā›, tapsyamānaḥ, 
	titapsamānaḥ, titapsiṣyamāṇaḥ; ityādīni rūpāṇi bhavantīti viśeṣaḥ .  [page0651+ 28] 
	→ā. “gūrṇe'smin bahujantughūriṇi khale jūrṇaiḥ śaśaṃse nṛbhiḥ

	→7. paryaṅke bandhaḥ paryaṅkabandhaḥ . “siddhaśuṣkapakvabandhaiśca” (2-1-41) iti saptamītatpuruṣaḥ . 
	“tatpuruṣe kṛti—” (6-3-14) iti prāptasyālukaḥ “nensiddhabaddhnātiṣu ca” 
	(6-3-19) iti niṣedhaḥ . 
	→8. anu badhyate ityanūbandhaḥ = pratyayagataḥ kittvaṅittvādirviśeṣaḥ . “upasargasya 
	ghañyamanuṣye bahulam” (6-3-122) iti dīrghaḥ . 
	→1. dhātoḥ saṃyogāntatvena gurutvāt, “gurośca halaḥ” (3-3-103) ityakārapratyaye rūpamevam . ktini vivakṣite tu kittvenopadhānakāralope baddhiḥ ityapi sādhuriti jñeyam . 
	→2. “adhikaraṇe bandhaḥ” (3-4-41) iti ṇamul . cakre baddha ityarthaḥ . kaṣāditvāt 
	yathāvidhyanuprayogaḥ . 
	→3. “saṃjñāyām” (3-4-42) iti ṇamul . aṭṭālikābandha iti bandhaviśeṣasya 
	saṃjñā . evaṃ krauñcabandhaṃ baddhaḥ, padmabandhaṃ baddhaḥ, śarabandhaṃ baddhaḥ, ityādiṣu sarvatra 
	ṇamulupapattirjñeyā . atra sarbatra bandhaḥ ityanena vyūhaviśeṣasya, kāvyagatasya bandhaviśeṣasya ca tantreṇa grahaṇamiti jñeyam . 
	→4. auṇādike [da. u. 1. 95] upratyaye rūpamevam . 
	→5. auṇādike [da. u. 8. 26] kiracpratyaye, pratyayasya kittvenopadhānakāralope ca 
	rūpamevam . baddhamasya śravaṇendriyamiti badhiraḥ = śrotrendriyahīnaḥ . 
	→6. “bandherbradhibudhi ca” (da. u. 5-38) iti nakpratyaye bradhi-budhi-ityādeśayośca

	devo vā . 
	→7. bāhulakādauṇādike uracpratyaye rūpam . “bandhūra bandhurau syātāṃ namrasundarayostriṣu.” 
	iti rantidevavacanād dīrghamadhyamo'pyastīti vijñāyate .

	“… ṛdittvamanudāttettvamātraphalam.” iti mā. dhā. vṛttiḥ . ṛdittvasya 
	tiṅanta evopayogādasmābhirubhāvapi dhātū samuccityopāttau . ghaṭādiṣveva phaṇādayaḥ 
	sapta dhātavo'nte paṭhitāḥ . tatra “ṭu bhrājṛ—” ityeva pāṭhaḥ ttyāsakāra-maitraiyarakṣita-puruṣakāra-sāyaṇa-siddhāntakaumudyādisammataḥ . kṣīrasvāmī tu 
	“bhrājṛ, ṭu bhrāśṛ—” ityādi paṭhitvā, “ṭurubhayasya—ityeke . “ṭvito'	thuc” (3-3-89) bhrājathuḥ.” ityāha . cāndrāṇāṃ kāśakṛtsnīyānāṃ 
	ca dhātupāṭhe bhrāja ityeva ghaṭādau paṭhitaḥ na tu “ṭu bhrājṛ” iti kṣī. ṭīkāyāṃ 
	pratipāditam . etat sarvamatrānusandheyam . “avaśyapaṭhitavyena pha[phā?]ṇādikena 
	bhrājate ityādīnāṃ siddheḥ iha (= ghaṭādibhinnasthale bhvādiṣu) pāṭho'nārṣa iva.” 
	iti nyāsakāravacanaṃ mā. dhā. vṛttau upāttamapyatrāvadheyam . 
	→1. “bhrājabhāsadhurvi—” (3-2-177) ityādinā tacchīlādiṣu kartṛṣu kvippratyayaḥ . 
	“coḥ kuḥ” (8-2-30) iti padānte kutvam . etacca ghaṭādiṣvarpāṃṭhatasya “bhrājṛ 
	dīptau, iti bhauvādikasya bhrājateḥ kvipi rūpamiti jñeyam . 
	→ā. “abhreji vibhrāgbhiranījitaiśca yat kadā'pyaśocadbhiraśeṣajantubhiḥ.” dhā. kā. 1. 25. 
	→2. “bhuvaśca” (3-2-138) ityatra cakāreṇāsmādapi dhātoḥ iṇṇucpratyaya iti kāśikādiṣūcyate . atrapi bhrājiṣṇuriti dvividhasyāpi bhrājateḥ sampadyate iti bahavaḥ . 
	“bhrājiṣṇunā lohitacandanena—” iti kāśikāmupādāya padamañjaryām—“naitad bhāṣye samāśritam.” ityuktam . idānīṃ bhāṣyakośeṣu “bhuvaśca” 
	(3-2-138) iti sūtrasya bhāṣyameva nopalabhāmahe . dhātukāvyavyākhyāne tu 
	(2-20) ghāṭādikasya “ṭu bhrājṛ—” iti dhātoḥ iṣṇucpratyaya iti pratipāditam . 
	→bh. “kṛṣṇo'pi reje pathi gopabālaiḥ bhrājiṣṇubhiḥ bhrāśitapārśvadeśaḥ.” dhā. kā. 2. 20. 
	→3. “ṭu bhrājṛ—” ityasya tācchīlike kvipi, “vraścabhrasjasṛjamṛjayajarājabhrāja—” 
	(8-2-36) ityanena ṣatve, jaśtvacartvayośca rūpamevam . kvibvidhāyake sūtre 
	kāśikāyām (3-2-177) vibhrāṭ ityudāhṛtatve'pi, sūtre ghaṭādipaṭhitayoḥ 
	taditarayorubhayorapi bhrājadhātvorgrahaṇameva; ṣatvaṃ tu “vraścabhrasja—” (8-2-36) 
	ityatra rājadhātusāhacaryāt phaṇādi (ghaṭādi) bhrājatereva ityādikaṃ prakṛtasthale 
	mā. dhā. vṛttau sphuṭam . 
	→4. “ṭvito'thuc” (3-3-89) iti bhāve'thucpratyaye rūpamevam . 
	→5. kartari liṭaḥ kvasau ghaṭāderanyatra paṭhitasya bhrājate rūpamevam . ghāṭādikasya 
	kvasau tu, “phaṇāṃ ca saptānām” (6-4-125) ityetvābhyāsalopavikalpaḥ . tena 
	rūpadvayamiti jñeyam . 
	→6. “bhrājate iti bhrātā” iti rūpaṃ kṣīrataraṅgiṇyāṃ, daśapādyuṇādivṛttau ca 
	(da. u. 2. 3) bhrājatestṛni, tṛci vā, pṛṣodarāditvāt (6-3-109) jakāralope 
	ca sādhitam . bhāṣye (1-2-68) tu “yadi tāvad bibhartīti bhrātā” 
	ityuktatvāt bibharterdhātoreva bhrātṛśabdaniṣpādanaṃ nyāyyamiti pratibhāti . 
	→7. “na bhrājate iti nabhrāṭ . nañsamāse, “na bhrāṇnapāt—” (6-3-75) ityādinā nañaḥ 
	prakṛtibhāvaḥ .

yama (1341) “yama ca pariveṣaṇe”  (X-curādiḥ-1626. saka. seṭ. ubha.) ‹[a]› “yameruparame yacchet yamayet pariveṣaṇe.” (ślo. 148) iti devaḥ . 
	yamakaḥ-yamikā, yiyamayiṣakaḥ-ṣikā, yamayitā-trī, yiyamayiṣitā-trī; 
	ityādīni sarvāṇyapi rūpāṇi caurādikacahayativat (515) jñeyāni . śatari ‹ā› suyamayan . 
	→[a] curādiṣu jñapādipañcakadhātuprakaraṇe “yama ca pariveṣaṇe” (ga. sū. curādau) 
	iti paṭhyate . tasyāyamarthaḥ—pariveṣaṇe = pariveṣṭane'rthe yamadhātuścurādiṣu 
	bodhyaḥ; tasya ca kramaprāpto mittvādistu bhavatīti . pariveṣaṇabhinnārthe tu autsargike bhvādipāṭhe, tasmāddhetumaṇṇici niyāmayati, niyāmakaḥ ityādikāni 
	rūpāṇi tiṅantādiṣu bhavantīti jñeyam . “yama ca—” iti durgādisammataḥ 
	pāṭhaḥ . cakārarahitapāṭhastu kṣīrataraṅgiṇīdṛṣṭaḥ . “apariveṣaṇe” ityapi 
	keṣāñcitpāṭha iti kṣīrataraṅgiṇyādito jñāyate; sa ca pāṭhaḥ puruṣakāramādhavadhātuvṛttiprabhṛtiṣu khaṇkṣita ityalam . pariveṣaṇam = veṣṭanam . bhvādiṣu 
	paṭhitasya “yamo'pariveṣaṇe” ityasya tu “pariveṣaṇam = bhojanam” ityartha 
	iti bodhyam .

rādha (1395) “rādha saṃsiddhau”  (IV-divādiḥ-1180. aka. ani. para.) ‹[a]› “rādhnoti saṃsiddhyarthe śnau, rādhyed vṛddhāvakarmakāt.” (ślo. 122) iti devaḥ .

	→[a] “rādho'karmakād vṛddhāveva” (ga. sū.) iti divādiṣu paṭhyate . asyāyamarthaḥ-evakāro bhinnakamaḥ . asmādakarmakādeva śyan . vṛddhigrahaṇaṃ tu udāharaṇapradarśanārtham

	śayana-krīkṣā-ruci-dīptyarthaṃ dhātugaṇaṃ tamakarmakamāhuḥ ..” ityupāttānāmarthānām vṛddhiśabda

	kāśyapoktirna samīcīnā; upāttasthaleṣu sarvatrākarmakatve mati vṛddhyarthatvābhāvāt . 
	vistarastu anyatra . 
	→1. “rādho'karmakād vṛddhāveva” (ga. sū. divādiṣu) iti śyan . striyām,

	vivakṣyante tadā vivṛtsakaḥ ityādīnīti bodhyam . yadā tu vivartiṣate iti 
	niṣpādya, tadantāt kṛtovivakṣyante, tadā vivartiṣakaḥ ityādi bhavati . evaṃ sannante 
	sarvatra rūpadvayaṃ bodhyam .

	suptvā-suptiḥ, ‹4› svapnaḥ, ‹5› svapnak, ‹6› suṣuptaḥ-viṣuptaḥ-niṣuptaḥ-duḥṣuptaḥ, suṣupsuḥ- ‹7› suṣvāpayiṣuḥ, iti viśeṣaḥ . 
	→[a] “ñi ṣvapa śaye” “halantyam” (1-3-3) itīttvaprasaṅgāt “ñi ṣvap śaye” 
	ityapapāṭhaḥ—iti dhātukāvyavyākhyānam (2-51) . yujyate caitat . yataḥ 
	sarveṣvapi dhātupāṭheṣu “ñi ṣvap śaye . udāttet, anudāttaḥ.” iti paṭhyate . 
	“udāttet” ityasya udāttopadeśo'kāra itsaṃjñako'tra dhātau—iti khalvarthaḥ . 
	ataśca prāmādikaḥ sārvatrikaḥ “ṣvap” iti halantapāṭha ityeva nyāyyam . ata 
	evāpapāṭhaḥ śodhito dhātukāvyavyākhyātṛmahāśayena . 
	→1. “rudavidamuṣagrahisvapipracchaḥ saṃśca” (1-2-8) iti sanaḥ kittvam . tena “vacisvapiyajādīnāṃ kiti” (6-1-15) iti samprasāraṇam . pūrvarūpādikam . tato 
	dvirvacanam . uttarakhaṇkṣe “ādeśapratyayayoḥ” (8-3-59) iti ṣatvam . 
	→2. “svapisyamivyeñāṃ yaṅi” (6-1-19) iti yaṅante samprasāraṇam . pūrvavat 
	abhyāsakāryāṇi . 
	→3. “ñītaḥ ktaḥ” (3-2-187) iti kartari bhāve ca vartamāne ktapratyayaḥ . niṣṭhāyāḥ 
	kittvāt samprasāraṇam . evaṃ ktvāktinyakprabhṛtiṣvapi bodhyam . 
	→4. “svapo nan” (3-3-91) iti bhāve nanpratyayaḥ . 
	→5. “svapitṛṣornajiṅ” (3-2-172) iti tācchīliko najiṅpratyayaḥ . najiṅi “naj” 
	ityevābaśiṣyate . jakārasya padānttvaprayuktaḥ kakāraḥ . 
	→6. “suvinirdurbhyaḥ supisūtisamāḥ” (8-3-88) iti ṣatvam . sūtre “supi” 
	iti kṛtasamprasāraṇanirdeśaḥ . tena samprasāraṇayogyasthaleṣu yatra “sup” iti 
	śravaṇaṃ tatra sarvatrāpi ṣatvaṃ bhavatīti bodhyam . 
	→7. ṇyantāt sani upratyaye rūpamevam . abhyāsasya “dyutisvāpyoḥ—” (7-4-67) 
	iti samprasāraṇam . “stautiṇyoreva ṣaṇi—” (8-3-61) ityuttarakhaṇkṣe ṣatvam .

	dhātuvṛttau “—ṣūrkṣa—” iti paṭhitvā “ādarānādare” iti kvacit paṭhyate . 
	tadasat; “somena yakṣyamāṇo narttūn sūrkṣan nakṣatram” iti darśanāt . somena 
	yakṣyamāṇo “vasante brāhmaṇo'gnīnādadhīta . uttarayoḥ phalgunyoragnimādadhīta” 
	ityādi[udita]ṛtunakṣatrāṇi nādriyeta iti sūtrārthaḥ . tathā— “avahekṣanamasūrkṣaṇam” 
	(amaraḥ nāṭyavarge) iti dṛśyate . sūrkṣaṇam = ādaraḥ tato'nyadasūrkṣaṇam anādaraḥ” 
	iti uktamatra anusandheyam . kṣīrataraṅgiṇyām “sūrkṣya anādare” ṣānto'yamiti 
	candraḥ” iti ca dṛśyate . sāyaṇena “anādare” iti pāṭho dūṣitaḥ . sarvāṇyapi  [page1376+ 33] 
	rūpāṇi bhauvādikacūṣativat (552) bodhyāni . ṇyati ‹ā› sūrkṣyam . 
	→ā. “sūrkṣya tvadīkṣā cirakāṅkṣatā naḥ….” dhā. kā. 1-85.

	→3. “ṇvultṛcau” (3-1-133) iti ṇvul . “ho hanterñṇinneṣu” (7-3-54) iti 
	hanterhakārasya kutvam . soṣmaṇo ghoṣavato nādavato mahāprāṇasya hakārasya tādṛśa eva 
	ghakāra ādeśo bhavati . idamuttaratrāpi ñit-ṇit-pratyayeṣu nakāre ca paratra bhavati . 
	“hanasto'ciṇṇaloḥ” (7-3-32) iti dhātunakārasya takāraḥ . 
	→4. ṇijante'pi sarvatra hanterhakārasya kutvaṃ ghakāraḥ, nakārasya takāraśca pūrvavat bodhyaḥ . 
	→5. sannante “ajjhanagamāṃ sani” (6-4-16) iti dīrghaḥ, dvirvacanādikam, abhyāse 
	“kuhoścuḥ” (7-4-62) iti cutvena jakāraḥ, “abhyāsācca” (7-3-55) iti 
	uttarakhaṇkṣe kutvam . nakārasyānusvāraḥ . evaṃ sannante sarvatra prakriyā bodhyā . 
	→6. “hanterhiṃsāyāṃ yaṅighnībhāvo vaktavyaḥ” (vā. 7-1-30) iti vacanāt yaṅi vivakṣite 
	sati hiṃsārthe'sya ghnībhāvaḥ, dvirvacanādikam . halādiśeṣaḥ . “abhyāse carca” 
	(8-4-54) iti abhyāse jakāraḥ . “guṇo yaṅlukoḥ” (7-4-82) iti guṇaḥ . 
	→1. gatyarthatve tu dhātoḥ “nugato'nunāsikāntasya” (7-4-85) iti nugāgamaḥ . nukaḥ 
	“padāntavat” ityatideśāt anusvāraḥ upalakṣyate . “abhyāsācca” (7-3-55) 
	ityuttarakhaṇkṣe'pi hakārasya kutvena ghakāraḥ . evaṃ sannante sarvatra bodhyam . 
	→2. “ṛddhanoḥ sye” (7-2-70) itīkṣāgamaḥ syapratyaye parataḥ . 
	→3. “āṅo yamahanaḥ” (1-3-28) iti akarmakādasmāt ātmanepadam . “akarmakāt” 
	(1-3-26) ityukteḥ “coramāghnan” ityatra passmaipadameva . “ājaghne viṣamavilocanasya 
	vakṣaḥ” (kirātārjunīye 17-63) “āhadhvaṃ raghūttamam” (bhaṭṭikāvye) ityādiṣu 
	sakarmakasthaleṣu ātmanepadaṃ cintyameveti mādhavācāryāḥ . pare tu pāṭhāntaraṃ tatratatrāśritya samāhitavantaḥ . “etya” iti adhyāhṛtya vakṣaḥ, raghūttamaṃ vā etya—iti 
	haradatto vyācakhyau . 
	→4. śatari, śapo luki, śatuḥ sārvadhātukatvena ṅidvadbhāvāt “gamahanajanakhanaghasāṃ lopaḥ 
	kṅiti anaṅi” (6-4-98) iti hanterupadhākārasya lopaḥ . “ho hanteḥ—” 
	(7-3-54) iti kutvena ghakāraḥ . “nergadanadapatapadaghumāsyatihanti—” (8-4-17) 
	iti upasargasthānnimittāduttarasya neḥ ṇatvam . 
	→5. “na gatihiṃsārthebhyaḥ” (1-3-15) iti karmavyatīhārātmanepadaniṣedhaḥ, dhātoḥ 
	hiṃsārthakatvāt gatyarthatvāt ca . 
	→6. “jāsiniprahaṇa—” (2-3-56) iti corasya ṣaṣṭhī . 
	→7. “anudāttopadeśa—” (6-4-37) ityādinā jhalādiṣu kṅitpratyayeṣu ktvā-ktin-ktaktavatuprabhṛtiṣu anunāsikalopaḥ . 
	→8. pādābhyāṃ hanyate = gamyate iti paddhatiḥ . atra dhātorgatyarthakam . ktin . “himakāṣihatiṣu ca” (6-3-54) iti pādaśabdasya padbhāvaḥ . bāhvāditvāt (4-1-96) ṅīṣi 
	paddhatī ityapīti mādhavaḥ . “padopahataḥ” ityatra tu “pādasya pad ājyātigopahateṣu” (6-3-52) iti padādeśaḥ . 
	→9. “vā hatajagdhapareṣu” (vā. 8-4-48) iti putratakārasya hataśabde pare vā dvitvam . 
	→10. kumārī cāsau hatā ceti karmadhāraye “gharūpakalpacelakṣbruvagotrahateṣu—” (6-3-43) 
	iti kumārīśabdasya hrasvaḥ . kumāryā hatā iti samāse tu na hrasvaḥ—kumārīhatā 
	ityeva . 
	→1. “nadyāḥ śeṣasyānyatarasyām” (6-3-44) iti hrasvavikalpaḥ . 
	→2. “kṛnnadyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ” (vā. 6-3-44) iti pratiṣedhānna hrasvaḥ . 
	→3. “ugitaśca” (6-3-45) iti pūrvapadasya hrasvavikalpaḥ . vidvacchreyasoḥ puṃvadbhāvo'pi 
	vṛttikāravacanādatreti bodhyam . 
	→4. mahacchabdasyāpi puṃvadbhāvo'tra ātreyeṇokta iti mādhavaḥ . 
	→5. “antaraparigrahe” (1-4-65) iti “antar” ityasya gatitvam . “kugatiprādayaḥ” 
	(2-2-18) iti samāse lyapi “vā lyapi” (6-4-38) iti vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt nāntāniṭo'sya dhātornakāralopo nityaḥ . antarhatya madhye hatvā ityarthaḥ . 
	parigrahārthe tu “antarhatvā mūṣikāṃ gataḥ śyenaḥ” ityatra na gatitvam . tena na 
	lyap . svabhāvādayaṃ yogaḥ hantiviṣayakaḥ . 
	→6. “kaṇemanasī śraddhāpratīghāte” (1-4-66) iti kaṇe, manasi ityanayoḥ gatitvam . 
	saptamyantapratirūpake ime . pūrvavat samāse lyap . kaṇeśabdo'bhilāṣārthakaḥ, manasiśabdo'pīti nyāsapadamañjaryau . “kaṇehatya manasihatya vā payaḥ pibati.” 
	abhilāṣanivṛttiparyantaṃ payaḥ pibatītyarthaḥ . niruktabhinnārthatve tu kaṇe hatvā, manasi 
	hatvā ityeva . idamapi sūtraṃ svabhāvāt hantiviṣaya eva pravṛttam . 
	→7. “hano vā vadha ca” (vā. 3-1-97) iti karmaṇi yat, prakṛtervadhādeśaśca . vadhyaḥ 
	vadhakarmībhūtaḥ . pakṣe ṇyati, kutve takāre ca ghātyaḥ . digāditvāt (4-3-54) 
	yataiva siddhamiti bhagavān kātyāyanaḥ . 
	→8. “hanasta ca” (3-1-108) iti bhāvārthe supyanupasarge upapade hanteḥ kyap . nakārasya 
	takāraśca . evaṃ bhrūṇahatyā ityādikamapi . strītvaṃ svabhāvāt . 
	→9. aśvahatyāśabdo'pi pūrvavat hanteḥ kyapi nakārasya takārādeśe siddhaḥ . kecinnedaṃ 
	paṭhantīti mādhavaḥ . 
	→10. atra śrutivākye chāndasatvāt nirupapadādapi hanteḥ kyap iti mādhavīye spaṣṭam . 
	→11. “hanterghatvaṃ ca” (vā. 6-1-12) iti vacanāt hanteḥ pacādyaci dvitvam, pūrvottarakhaṇkṣayorghakāro hakārasya, pūrvakhaṇkṣe āk āgamaśca . “ghanāghanaḥ = varṣukameghaḥ, hantā 
	ca” iti prakriyāsarvasvam . “ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām” (tai. saṃ. 4-6-4-1) . 
	→12. śatruṃ vadhyāt ityāśīrarthe gamye “āśiṣi hanaḥ” (3-2-49) iti karmaṇyupapade 
	kṣapratyayaḥ . kṣittvāt ṭilopaḥ . evaṃ timirahaḥ, arātihaḥ ityādyapi . 
	→13. “dārāvāhano'ṇ antasya ca ṭaḥ saṃjñāyām” (vā. 3-2-49) iti dāruśabda upapade 
	āṅpūrvāt hanteḥ kartari aṇ, nakārasya ṭakāraḥ—saṃjñāyām . antyasya pratyayasya 
	ṇittvāt dhātorghaḥ . dārvāghāṭaḥ pakṣiviśeṣaḥ, yasya cañcūrubhayatra pratirūQā 
	kuddālavat . anyatra tu dārvāghātaḥ ityeva . 
	→1. cāru āhantīti cārvāghāṭaḥ—cārvāghāto vā . “cārau vā” (vā. 3-2-49) 
	iti pūrvavat kartari aṇ, antyasya ṭakāravikalpaḥ . pratyayasya ṇittvāt dhātorghakāraḥ . 
	→2. varṇān saṃhantīti varṇasaṃghāṭaḥ varṇasaṃghāto vā . “karmaṇi sami ca” (vā. 3-2-49) 
	iti pūrvavat aṇādikam . 
	→3. “ape kleśatamasoḥ” (3-2-50) iti kleśatamasorupapadayoḥ apapūrvakāt hanteḥ kṣaḥ . 
	kṣittvāt ṭilopaḥ . 
	→4. atra “kvip ca” (3-2-76) iti kvip . supi “sau ca” (6-4-13) iti dīrghe, 
	nalopaḥ . striyām, “ṛnnebhyaḥ—” (4-1-5) iti nāntatvalakṣaṇaṅīb na bhavati, 
	“bahvādiṣu (ga. sū. 4-1-45) ṅīṣvikalpārthaṃ “han” iti pāṭhāt” iti mādhavaḥ . 
	iyameva gatiḥ jvarāpahā, niśśeṣajākṣyāpahā ityādiṣvapi . kṣīrasvāmī tu 
	“anyebhyo'pi” iti kṣapratyaye parikhetyādivat sādhitavān . 
	→5. liṭaḥ kvasau, “vibhāṣā gamahanavidaviśām” (7-2-68) iti vā ikṣāgamaḥ . 
	iṭpakṣe jaghnivān iti, ikṣabhāvapakṣe jaghanvān iti ca rūpam . ghatvopadhākāralopādikaṃ pūrvavat bodhyam . 
	→6. “anyebhyo'pi—” iti kṣapratyaye kṣīrasvāmī etān sādhayati . tādṛśaṃ 
	vacanaṃ na dṛśyate . gamerkṣapratyayavidhāyakaṃ vacanamasya vivakṣitamiti bhāti . 
	varaṃ āhantīti varāhaḥ . paṭe hanyate iti paṭahaḥ . kalaṃ = mādhuryaṃ hantīti 
	kalahaḥ . 
	→7. “sampṛca…muṣābhyāhanaśca” (3-2-142) iti tācchīliko ghinuṇ . 
	ghatvatatve ca . 
	→8. “kumāraśīrṣayorṇiniḥ” (3-2-51) iti ṇinipratyayaḥ . ghatvatatve ca . atraiva nipātanāt 
	śirasaḥ śīrṣādeśaḥ . “kutsita iti vaktavyam” (vā. 3-2-93) iti vacanādatra 
	kutsā dyotyā . 
	→9. “lakṣaṇe jāyāpatyoṣṭak” (3-2-52) iti ṭakpratyayo lakṣaṇavati kartari . sūtre “lakṣaṇe” 
	iti lakṣaṇavato nirdeśaḥ . “gamahana—” (6-4-98) iti upadhākāralopaḥ . ghatvam . 
	jāyāghnaḥ tilakālakaviśeṣavān . yasya hastādiṣu jāyāmaraṇalakṣayitṛ tilākāraṃ 
	kālakaṃ vidyate sa evamucyate . evaṃ yasyāḥ striyāḥ pāṇau patihananasūcikā rekhā 
	vidyate socyate patighnī pāṇirekhā iti . jāyāghnaḥ patighnī ityatra 
	viśeṣyavaśāt niyataliṅgatā . 
	→1. “amanuṣyakartṛke ca” (3-2-53) iti ṭak . pūrvavat prakriyā . śleṣmaghnam madhu, 
	pittaghnaṃ jambīraphalam, vātaghnaḥ śākaviśeṣaḥ . 
	→2. ākhuṃ hantītyarthe “karmaṇyaṇ” (3-2-1) ityaṇ . ghatvatatve ca . 
	→3. atra “kaprakaraṇe mūlavibhujādibhyaḥ—” (vā. 3-2-5) iti kapratyaye, upadhākāralope, 
	ghatve ca rūpamiti kecit . mādhavastu kṛtaṃ hantītyarthe “kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam” 
	(3-3-113) iti bahulagrahaṇāt ṭakpratyayamavādīt . evameva kriyamāṇaghnaḥ, 
	kariṣyamāṇaghnaḥ, śatrughnaḥ ityādiṣvapi gatiḥ . ṭaki kṛtaghnī iti; ke kṛtaghnā 
	iti ca striyāṃ bhavet . 
	→4. gaurhanyate'smai iti goghnaḥ = atithiḥ . “dāśagoghnau sampradāne” (3-4-73) iti 
	sūtre nipātanādeva sampradāne ṭakpratyayaḥ . ajanto'yamiti prakriyāsarvasvam . 
	→5. hastihanane śakta evamucyate . “śaktau hastikapāṭayoḥ” (3-2-54) iti hanteṣṭak . 
	hastighno bhaṭaḥ . kapāṭaghnaḥ coraḥ . aśaktau yo viṣādibhirhastiṃ hanti saḥ 
	hastighātaḥ . evam—yaḥ kuṭhārādibhirbahubhiḥ sādhanaiḥ kapāṭaṃ hanti sa ucyate 
	kapāṭaghāta iti . ubhayatra “karmaṇyaṇ” (3-2-1) ityaṇ . “—kavāṭayoḥ” iti 
	sūtre pāṭhabhedaḥ . 
	→6. “pāṇighatākṣaghau śilpini” (3-2-55) iti nipātanāt hanteṣṭaki ṭilope, 
	ghatve ca rūpam . pāṇiṃ hantīti pāṇighaḥ hastenaiva tālavādyaprāvīṇyapradarśayitā . 
	tākṣaṃ = hanuṃ hantīti tākṣaghaḥ mukhenaiva vādyaviśeṣavādayitā . 
	→7. pitṛvyaṃ hatavān pitṛvyaghātī . “karmaṇi hanaḥ” (3-2-86) iti hanterbhūte ṇiniḥ . 
	→8. hanteḥ “brahmabhrūṇavṛtreṣu kvip” (3-2-87) iti kvip . hantereva, brahmādiṣveva, 
	kvibeva, bhūte eva iti caturvidho'tra sūtre niyamaḥ . brahma hatavān brahmahā . bhrūṇaṃ = garbhaṃ 
	hatavān bhrūṇahā . vṛtraṃ hatavān vṛtrahā indraḥ . “sau ca” (6-4-13) iti dīrghaḥ . 
	evaṃ niyamāṅgīkārāt himahā, keśihā, kālaneminihā ityādiṣu “kvip 
	ca” (3-2-76) iti sārvatrikaḥ kvip . 
	→9. dvitīyābahuvacanāntamidam . atra “prātipadikāntanumvibhaktiṣu ca” (8-2-154) 
	iti ṇatvavikalpaḥ . 
	→10. “laṣapatapadasthābhūbṛṣahana—” (3-2-154) iti ukañ tācchīlikaḥ . ghatvatatve . 
	striyāṃ ghātukī . 
	→11. “bahulaṃ taṇyannavadhaka—” (vā. 2-4-54) iti vacanāt ṇvuli prakṛteḥ vadhādeśaḥ . 
	so'yamakārāntādeśaḥ . yadvā halantatve'pi “janivadhyośca” (7-3-15) iti 
	vṛddhiniṣedhaḥ . 
	→1. “hanaśca vadhaḥ” (3-3-76) iti bhāve'ppratyaye prakṛtervadhādeśaḥ . 
	→2. “ghañarthe kavidhānaṃ sthāsnāpāvyadhihaniyudhyartham” (vā. 3-3-58) iti kapratyayaḥ . 
	viśeṣeṇa hantīti vighnaḥ . 
	→3. “mūrtau ghanaḥ” (3-3-77) iti hanterappratyaye prakṛterghanādeśaḥ; kāṭhinye gamye . 
	mūrtiḥ = kāṭhinyam . abbhraghanaḥ = abbhrasya kāṭhinyamityarthaḥ . ghanaṃ dadhi . 
	viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭavastuno'pi mūrtiśabdena grahaṇamiti prakriyāsarvasvam . 
	→4. “antarghano deśe” (3-3-78) iti nipātanāt deśe vācye antaḥpūrvakādasmāt 
	appratyaye prakṛterghanādeśaḥ . antarghanaḥ = vāhīkagrāmaviśeṣaḥ . antaḥ madhye hanyate	'treti vṛttiḥ . “antarghaṇaḥ” iti kṛtaṇatvaṃ kecit sūtra eva paṭhanti . teṣāṃ, 
	“antaśśabdasya aṅkividhiṇatveṣu upasargatvaṃ vaktavyam” (vā. 1-4-65) ityuktyaiva 
	siddhaṃ ṇatvam-iti bhāvaḥ . 
	→5. “agāraikadeśe praghaṇaḥ praghāṇaśca” (3-3-79) iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ . bāhyaprakoṣṭhake'linde vā vācye prapūrvakāddhanteḥ appratyaye prakṛteḥ ghanādeśaḥ “praghāṇaḥ” 
	ityatra dīrghaḥ, ṇatvaṃ ca nipātanalabhyāni . “praghaṇaḥ” ityatra tu “hanteratpūrvasya” 
	(8-4-22) iti ṇatvaṃ siddhameva . 
	→6. ut upari yasya nidhāya anyat kāṣṭhādikaṃ takṣyate tasmin = atyādhāne vivakṣite 
	“udghano'tyādhānam” (3-3-80) iti nipātanāt pūrvavat ghanādeśādikam . 
	→7. apa hanyate iti “apaghano'ṅgam” (3-3-81) iti nipātanāt sādhuḥ . 
	→8. ayaḥ hanyate yena saḥ ayoghanaḥ kūṭaḥ . vihanyate yena saḥ vighanaḥ = samīkaraṇasādhanam . druḥ hanyate yena saḥ drughanaḥ = kuṭhārādiḥ . “karaṇe'yovidruṣu” (3-3-82) 
	iti hano'ppratyaye ghanādeśaḥ . “drughaṇaḥ” iti kecit . tadānīm, “pūrvapadāt 
	saṃjñāyāmagaḥ” (8-4-3) iti, arīhaṇādiṣu (4-2-80) “drughaṇaḥ” iti pāṭhādvā 
	ṇatvamatreti jñeyam . 
	→9. stambaśabda upapade karaṇe hanaḥ kapratyayaḥ; ap ca . “stambe ka ca” (3-3-83) iti 
	kapratyaye stambaghnaḥ . appratyaye tu stambaghanaḥ iti . dātrādikamevamucyate—yena 
	stambaḥ tṛṇaviśeṣo hanyate . vistarastu mādhavīye draṣṭavyaḥ . 
	→10. “parau ghaḥ” (3-3-84) iti parāvupapade karaṇe hanterappratyayaḥ, ghaśca prakṛteḥ 
	sarvādeśaḥ . pari hanyate iti parighaḥ = argalam . “pareśca ghāṅkayoḥ” 
	(8-2-22) iti latvavikalpaḥ . tena palighaḥ ityapi . 
	→11. “pratighaḥ” iti bāhulakāt-ityātreyaḥ—iti mādhavaḥ . pratighaḥ kopaḥ . 
	“anyebhyo'pi—” (3-2-101) iti kṣapratyaye nyakṣkvāditvāt kutvamiti” 
	bhānudīkṣitaḥ . 
	→1. upaghnaḥ = pratyāsannaḥ “upaghna āśraye” (3-3-85) iti nipātanāt hanterappratyaye 
	upadhālopaḥ . parvatenopahanyate = gamyate iti parvatopaghnaḥ . atra dhātoḥ gatyarthakatvam . 
	→2. samudbhyāṃ parasya hanteḥ appratyaye saṃghe praśaṃsāyāṃ ca gamyamāne sati “saṃghoddhau gaṇapraśaṃsayoḥ” (3-3-86) iti nipātanāt ghatvam . saṃhananaṃ saṃghaḥ = prāṇisamudāyaḥ . 
	bhāve'p . anyatra saṃghātaḥ . uddhanyate = utkṛṣṭatayā jñāyata iti gatyarthānāṃ 
	jñānārthatvāt udghaḥ = praśastaḥ, karmaṇyaṇ . anyatra udghātaḥ . 
	→3. saṃpūrvakāt asmāt ghañi ghatvatatvayoḥ saṃghātaśabdaḥ sādhuḥ . gha-ghañoḥ pratyayayorapavādo'treti manvāna ātreyaḥ “hantyarthāśca” (ga. sū. curādiḥ) iti curādipāṭhāt, 
	ṇijantāt saṃghātaśabdaniṣpattimāheti mādhavaḥ . 
	→4. hantīti hetiḥ . hanyate'neneti vā “ūtiyūtijūtisātiheti—” (3-3-97) iti 
	nipātanāt nalope, prakṛtyakārasyekāre ca hetiḥ iti mādhavaḥ . 
	→5. “nigho nimitam” (3-3-87) iti nipātanāt nipūrvakādasmāt appratyaye sādhuḥ . 
	nimitam = samantāt mitam, samārohapariṇāhamityarthaḥ . nirviśeṣaṃ hanyante iti 
	nighāḥ vṛkṣāḥ, śālayaśca . 
	→6. nighnaḥ āyattaḥ, adhīnaḥ . nipūrvakādasmāt, bāhulakāt, “ghañarthe kavidhānam—” 
	(vā. 3-3-58) iti vā kapratyayaḥ . 
	→7. “samūlākṛtajīveṣu han—” (3-4-36) iti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ samūle upapade ṇamul . 
	“kaṣādiṣu yathāvidhi—” (3-4-46) iti vacanāt ṇamulprayojakasyeva hanteranu 
	prayogaḥ . “kṛnmejantaḥ” (1-1-39) ṇamulantamavyayam iti . 
	→8. “karaṇe hanaḥ” (3-4-37) iti ṇamul . pāṇinā hantītyarthaḥ . kaṣāditvāt 
	(3-4-46) pūrvaprayuktasyaivānuprayogaḥ . 
	→9. “hiṃsārthānāṃ ca samānakarmakāṇām” (3-4-48) iti ṇamul . 
	→10. “hanteratpūrvasya” (8-4-22) iti ṇatvam .

hṛñ (2016) “hṛñ haraṇe”  (I-bhvādiḥ-899. saka. ani. ubha.) “prasahyahṛtyāṃ haraṇe jiharti harate haret ..” (ślo. 27) iti devaḥ . 
	haraṇam = prāpaṇam, svīkāraḥ, stainyam, nāśanaṃ ca . ‹1› hārayan bhāraṃ devadattaṃ yajñadatto gacchati, ‹2› saṃpraharamāṇā rājānaḥ, “tataḥ ‹3› samprahariṣyantau dṛṣṭvā karṇadhanañjayau’, paitṛkamaśvāḥ ‹4› anuharamāṇāḥ, mātṛkaṃ gāvo'nuharamāṇāḥ, śatasya ‹5› vyavaharan-ntī, ‹6› pratihartā, ‹7› hariṣyan-ntī, hariṣyamāṇaḥ, ‹8› avahāraḥ, ‹9› aṃśaharaḥ, ‹10› bhārahāraḥ, ‹11› kavacaharaḥ, ‹12› puṣpāharaḥ,  [page1419+ 33] ‹1› dṛtihariḥ-nāthaharirvā paśuḥ, ‹2› saṃhāraḥ, avahāraḥ, ‹3› hāraḥ, ‹4› hārā, ‹5› āhāraḥ, ‹6› haraḥ-paśyatoharaḥ, ‹7› hariḥ-hariṇī, haritaḥ, hṛdayam, harimāṇaḥ, harīmā, 
	prahiḥ, hareṇuḥ, iti viśeṣarūpāṇi . sāmānyarūpāṇi bhauvādikabharativat 
	(1170) bodhyāni . 
	→1. “hṛkroranyatarasyām” (1-4-53) iti aṇau kartuḥ ṇau karmasaṃjñā; tena devadattaśabdāt 
	dvitīyā . 
	→2. haraterhiṃsārthatve'pi “na gatirhisārthebhyaḥ” (1-3-15) iti ātmanepadaniṣedho na bhavati . 
	“hṛvahyorapratiṣedhaḥ” (vā. 1-3-15) iti vacanāt . 
	→3. atra yuddhābhimukhyamātramarthaḥ, na tu karmavyatīhāraḥ-tena parasmaipadam . vistarastvatra 
	mādhavīye draṣṭavyaḥ . 
	→4. “haratergatatācchīlye” (vā. 1-3-21) iti ātmanepadam . gataṃ = prakāraḥ, tasya 
	svabhāvaḥ tācchīlyam . pitṛguṇamaśvāḥ, mātṛguṇaṃ gāvaśca labhante iti vākyārthaḥ . 
	“gatitācchīlye” iti nyāsakārakṣīrasvāminau . gatiḥ = gamanam . arthāt 
	vegādikaṃ gṛhyate . 
	→5. karmaṇaḥ “vyavahṛpaṇoḥ samarthayoḥ” (2-3-57) iti śeṣe ṣaṣṭhī “śatasya” iti . 
	→6. “tṛnvidhau ṛtvikṣu cānupasargasya” (vā. 3-2-135) iti vacanāt atra ca sopasargatvāt “ṇvultṛcau” (3-1-133) iti tṛc . pratihartā = ṛtvigviśeṣaḥ . 
	→7. dhātoraniṭtve'pi sye “ṛddhanoḥ sye” (7-2-70) itīkṣāgamaḥ . 
	→8. avaharatīti avahāraḥ = grāhaḥ, graho vā . “śyādvyadhāśrusaṃsravatīṇavasāvahṛ—” 
	(3-1-141) iti kartari ṇapratyayaḥ . 
	→9. aṃśaṃ haratīti aṃśaharaḥ . “harateranudyamane'c” (3-2-9) iti acpratyayaḥ . 
	anudyamanam = anupekṣaṇam, yasya haraṇena śārīraka udyamaḥ = prayatno na bhavati 
	taducyate . 
	→10. śārīraka udyame vivakṣite tu “karmaṇyaṇ” (3-2-1) iti atra aṇpratyayaḥ . 
	upapadasamāsaḥ . vṛddhiḥ . 
	→11. “vayasi ca” (3-2-10) iti karmopapadādasmāt vayasi gamye harateracpratyayaḥ . 
	kavacaharaḥ = kavacadhāraṇayogyavayoviśiṣṭa ityarthaḥ . 
	→12. āṅupasṛṣṭāt, karmopapadāt asmāt tācchīlye gamye “āṅi tācchīlye” 
	(3-2-11) iti ac . puṣpāharaḥ = yaḥ puṣpavikrayādibhiḥ, mālāgrathanādibhiśca 
	puṣpaikajīvī, sa ucyate . evaṃ tṛṇāharaḥ, darbhāharaḥ, śākāharaḥ ityādyapyudāhāryam . 
	→1. dṛtiśabde nāthaśabde ca karmabhūte upapade sati paśau viśeṣye, “haraterdṛtināthayoḥ 
	paśau” (3-2-25) itīnpratyayaḥ . dṛtiṃ = carmabhastrikāṃ haratīti dṛtihariḥ = śvā . 
	nāthaṃ = nāsārajjuṃ haratīti nāthahariḥ = paśuḥ . 
	→2. saṃhriyante'nena, atra iti vā saṃhāraḥ = yuddham, pralayaśca . “adhyāyanyāyodyāvasaṃhārāśca” (3-3-122) iti nipātanāt ghañ . sūtre cakārasyānuktasamuccāyārthakatvāt avahāraḥ ityapīti kāśikā . avahāraḥ = coraḥ . ghāpavādo ghañ . 
	upasargeṇa dhātorarthāḥ bhidyante; tathācoktaṃ pūrvaiḥ—“upasargeṇa dhātvartho balādanyatra nīyate . 
	vihārāhārasaṃhāraprahāraparihāravat ..” iti . 
	→3. “akartari ca kārake saṃjñāyām” (3-3-19) iti ghañ . hriyate paśyatāṃ mano'neneti 
	hāraḥ = muktādisaraḥ . 
	→4. bhidādi (3-3-104) pāṭhāt striyāmaṅi, “ṛdṛśo'ṅi—” (7-4-16) iti guṇe, 
	gaṇapāṭhādeva dīrghe ca rūpam . haraṇaṃ hārā . 
	→5. āhriyante'smāt rasāḥ iti āhāraḥ bhojanam . evam abhyavahāraḥ ityapi . 
	atra “akartari ca—” (3-3-19) iti ghañ . 
	→6. harati pāpādikamiti haraḥ = śivaḥ . pacādyac . praṇatārti haratīti praṇatārtiharaḥ . 
	atra “harateranudyamane—” (3-2-9) iti ac . paśyantaṃ anādṛtya haratīti 
	paśyatoharaḥ-kasyacitsaṃjñā . “ṣaṣṭhī cānādare” (2-3-38) iti ṣaṣṭhī . “ṣaṣṭhyā 
	ākrośe” (6-3-21) iti ṣaṣṭhyā aluk . 
	→7. harati natānāṃ kleśādīn iti hariḥ = viṣṇuḥ . atra “haraterdṛtināthayoḥ paśau” 
	(3-2-25) ityatra yogavibhāgena inpratyayaḥ . kecit tu yogavibhāge bhāṣyādipramāṇābhāvāt auṇādike inpratyaye sādhayanti .
